approximations: pbrt: equirect env resampled to a 512x512 equal-area octahedral image (pbrt-v4 only accepts that layout); scale and rotationYDeg baked in; pbrt looks up nearest-pixel while Mitsuba interpolates bilinearly.
pbrt: material 'm0_Simple_Base': dielectric over diffuse is pbrt's stochastic LayeredBxDF (maxdepth 64, nsamples 1); OpenPBR approximates the layering with albedo scaling
pbrt: material 'm1_Simple_Coated': clear coat on a dielectric: coateddiffuse with the coat IOR/roughness as the interface; the base dielectric specular lobe is not added
pbrt: material 'm2_Simple_Coating': dielectric over diffuse is pbrt's stochastic LayeredBxDF (maxdepth 64, nsamples 1); OpenPBR approximates the layering with albedo scaling
